description: Fetch one record by sobject + id, optionally trimmed to specific fields. Requires sobject and id.
embedding_description: Read one Salesforce CRM record by object type and record id, optionally limiting the response to a chosen field list. Use this focused single-record lookup when you already hold the API object name and id for an Account, Contact, Opportunity, or custom object.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with record: a mapping of field API names to values.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show the requested fields; record data may contain sensitive CRM content (data_sensitivity 0.3) — surface for downstream use but never treat as public.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch one Salesforce record by sobject and id.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: missing sobject or id. sf.not_found: no record with that id exists for that sobject. sf.permission_denied: the CLI's authenticated user cannot read this object or record.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.not_found: verify the id and sobject are correct, e.g. via soql_query. sf.permission_denied: ask the operator to check field-level and object-level security for the CLI's authenticated user.
